label: Exploratory V5 forward-Seam-Pin with 128 Escape Slack candidate C4
assumptions: This is not nimble-knots-artillery-v5 and has no runtime, replay, protocol, or reward authority.
It keeps Candidate B2's ideal-direct-hit range/damage and forward-Stitch rules, then gives each actor an equal non-refilling 128-unit Escape Slack allowance for the entire match.

Only the portion of a movement action that increases current separation spends the acting character's own Escape Slack. Approach, holding, and stationary casts spend none; an exhausted actor may still fight or move closer but cannot increase separation.
Fire still ends the caster's turn. Terrain, aim, splash, animation, UI, and production counter-effects remain excluded.
